profile.headline: Autonomous Software Engineer at Johns Hopkins Applied Physics Lab

positions.title: Autonomous Maritime Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Professional Staff Member

Select projects: 
- REPAIR: https://secwww.jhuapl.edu/2024-Annual-Report/defending-the-nation#transforming-naval-maintenance
- UMAA: https://secwww.jhuapl.edu/2023-Annual-Report/article/defending-the-nation#leveraging-autonomy

company.name: The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory

positions.title: Guidance Navigation and Control Engineer Sr
Creative Machines Lab Research Assistant
positions.description:
Used python to code calibration method and analyze IMU data from our robot Spyndra to measure gait repeatability

Coded sections of a neural network in Python to construct predictions from IMU data using 22 inputs with the goal of Spyndra learning to self-model

Wrote portions of the research paper in accordance with summer work that will be submitted for publication in the fall

Presented project abstract at the 2017 Naval Academy Science and Engineering Conference (chosen to attend by Columbia with four students)

company.name: Columbia University in the City of New York

positions.title: Business Strategy Intern
positions.description:
Conducted case studies of over 20 corporations to analyze industry strategies and innovative techniques

Researched potential accelerator and startup partnerships and presented proposals to management

Conducted business calls with potential partners to gauge fit and mutual benefits
